svg.title: How an email is delivered
svg.desc:
How an email is delivered Written as JSON: no Python needed. Draw it with: open-diagram draw examples/email_delivery.json States shown: Live, Being built, In trial, Planned. Solid lines: data flows today. This year: 1. Sign every message (Sending server); 2. Check every link (Receiving server).
Blocks, left to right: - Mail app: Write; Attach files; Send - Sending server [step 1] (The sender's provider): Queue; Digital signature (being built); Retry if busy - Receiving server [step 2] (The recipient's provider): Check the sender; Spam filter; Link scanner (planned) - Inbox: Phone; Laptop; Smartwatch (in trial) Lines: - Mail app -> Sending server - Sending server -> Receiving server, labeled "over the internet" - Receiving server -> Inbox - Receiving server -> Sending server, labeled "If delivery fails, a bounce message goes back"
